items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Chino Posto in relation to Mario Bauza; Interviewee confirms Bauza's background but does not mention any personal interaction with Chino Posto.

ctx.x: He was a mechanical trumpet player (inaudible) the best. (Inaudible).

It's been suggested that he did Javarro (phonetic) -- I think it was Javarro, one of the numbers he played with Chino Posto -- but anyway, one of the numbers that he did play with Chino Posto that he had more understanding of Afro-Cuban rhythms than most jazz trumpeters in the early days because he came from deep South Florida.
